jobs.scene: A cinematic architectural paper collage of TWO COMPLETE apartment interiors side by side as freestanding miniature cutaway rooms, both with fully visible outer borders. Left: a modest one-bedroom with one chair, one bed and a compact kitchen; right: a larger two-bedroom with two beds in separate rooms and a shared kitchen and two chairs. No people. One small brass key ring below left, two brass key rings below right. Ivory walls, burgundy fabric details, warm shadows, visual balance, no writing, labels or prices. Composition conveys sharing household costs without pretending the rooms are identical.

jobs.scene: An evocative editorial collage: three fully visible modest American residential buildings rising behind a large blank cream lease paper in the foreground; one burgundy upward arrow made from torn paper sits separately beside the lease. A complete small brass key ring rests in front. Architectural photography cutouts, restrained metropolitan texture. This is an abstract metaphor of rising rent, NOT a numerical chart; no data points, numbers, axis, currency or written marks. Buildings clear and discrete, no licensed landmarks.

jobs.scene: A domestic still-life editorial paper collage with three visually separated clusters: a complete running ivory refrigerator and dark wifi router on left; a kraft grocery bag, spinach leaves and two plain food containers at center; a complete brown moving box holding cookware next to one blank cream deposit envelope on right. Wide composition, all items intact and comfortably inside frame. Tactile photographic objects, muted burgundy accent circle behind center. No text, brand labels or written marks.

jobs.scene: A quiet empty home workspace: complete wooden desk with an unbranded closed laptop, one totally blank cream pay envelope, and a blank calendar with burgundy binding. A single empty chair beside desk and one modest apartment front door standing as a separate paper cutout on the right. A small torn burgundy paper strip between pay envelope and door visually suggests a fragile connection, not an accurate chart. Melancholy but dignified, no disaster imagery. Full silhouettes, no words or numbers.

jobs.scene: A warm private reading corner: one fictional adult with short dark brown hair wearing cream sweater and dark trousers seated comfortably in a burgundy armchair, holding an entirely blank-cover book. Full seated person visible from top of hair through hands and both feet; whole armchair and complete floor lamp within generous margins. Realistic photographic paper cutouts with white edges, not cartoon. A small leafy plant, soft window light and calm open space. Privacy, rest and safety conveyed without assigning a money value. No text.
